name: Yuna's Decision
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Continue the Pilgrimage — Sacrifice a creature. If you do, draw a card, then you may put a creature card and/or a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
• Find Another Way — Return one or two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand.
blocked_sentences: • Find Another Way — Return one or two target permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand

needs.what: a mode-owned target spec (target `mode: 1` on a sorcery whose effect tree is one top-level choose_mode) whose size the caster picks -- `kind: "card_in_graveyard", count: 2, min_count: 1, up_to: true` over permanent cards in your graveyard -- declared only when the Find Another Way bullet is chosen, while the other bullet (Continue the Pilgrimage) declares no targets at all
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `loader.targets._check_mode_targets` refuses a `variable_size` mode-owned spec because `filter_legal` splits the stored refs by position. A fixed `count: 2` would make the mode illegal with only one permanent card in the graveyard and forbid returning just one. A card-level up_to target with no `mode` would be declared, and would need a legal target, even when the caster picks the targetless sacrifice/draw mode. The first bullet can be expressed: `sacrifice` with `as`, an `if` on the binding existing, `draw`, then two `may` + `put_onto_battlefield` from hand (one Creature, one Land)
